title: Roasted Cauliflower and Brown Rice Salad
subtitle: with Minted Pea Dressing
description: Main course salads have never looked so wholesome. There's cauliflower and green peas, brown rice to keep bellies full, and almonds for crunch – all drizzled with a refreshing minty yoghurt.

steps.text: Prep vegetables: Fill a medium saucepan three-quarters full with water and bring to the boil for the rice. Preheat the oven to 220C. Line an oven tray with baking paper. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Trim the cauliflower and cut into large florets. Pick the mint leaves, discarding the stems.

Cook rice: Cook the rice in the pan of boiling water for 25 mins or until tender. Drain, then return to the pan and cover to keep warm. Put the almonds in a cold small frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan.

Roast cauliflower: Meanwhile, bring a small saucepan of water to the boil for the peas. Put the cauliflower, 1 tbs olive oil and half the garlic on the lined tray. Season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Roast, turning once, for 15 mins or until the cauliflower is golden and tender.

Make dressing: Cook the peas in the pan of boiling water for 2 mins or until bright green. Drain, then run under cold running water until cool. Put the yoghurt, remaining garlic, half the peas, half the mint leaves, 1 tbs white wine vinegar and 1 tsp honey in a food processor. Season with salt and pepper, then process until smooth.
Serve up: Put the roasted cauliflower, rice, almonds, currants, remaining peas and remaining mint in a large bowl and toss gently to combine. Divide among bowls, drizzle over the dressing and enjoy!
Make it yours: This salad would also be lovely at room temperature, so make it ahead of time, keeping the dressing and mint leaves separate. Toss them through the salad just before serving.
